texts.preamble: Pradeep Kumar Gupta vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 18 December, 2023 Author: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi Bench: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ? Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:239282-Db Court No. - 40 Case :- Writ - C No. - 39896 of 2023 Petitioner :- Pradeep Kumar Gupta
texts.facts: 2. The present petition is preferred assailing the validity of the impugned order dated 23.09.2023 passed by Assistant Commissioner (Food), Grade-II, Food Safety and Drug Administration, District Pradeep Kumar Gupta vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167530818/ 1 Mahoba.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in response to the said leave, the petitioner has already sent the appeal through registered post, which is pending consideration. 5. The said claim is resisted by learned A.C.S.C. stating that while passing the impugned order, leave was accorded to the petitioner by the prescribed authority to file an appeal as per the relevant provisions but instead of filing appropriate appeal, he has sent it through registered post which is not permissible. 6. In reply, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner tried to move an appeal but the same had been refused and thereafter the petitioner sent the appeal on the prescribed format through registered post on 11.10.2022 well within time.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in response to the said leave, the petitioner has already sent the appeal through registered post, which is pending consideration. 5. The said claim is resisted by learned A.C.S.C. stating that while passing the impugned order, leave was accorded to the petitioner by the prescribed authority to file an appeal as per the relevant provisions but instead of filing appropriate appeal, he has sent it through registered post which is not permissible. 6. In reply, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner tried to move an appeal but the same had been refused and thereafter the petitioner sent the appeal on the prescribed format through registered post on 11.10.2022 well within time.
